import csv,importlib.util,json
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('test-results/pr33824_expanded_all13_predictors_20260928_1933')
helper=Path('tools/append_pr33824_expanded_report.py')
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('historical_report_readback',helper)
module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(module)
models=module.key_values(root/'run_metadata.txt')['models'].split(',')
out=root/'verification/historical_identity_report_readback_20260929_0306';out.mkdir()
lines=module.historical_request_identity_details(root,models,out)
rows=module.read_csv(out/'historical_train_test_request_identity.csv')
assert len(rows)==13
assert sum(int(r['real_to_replay_ids_verified']) for r in rows)==8320

(out/'report_sections.md').write_text(text,encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'models':len(rows),'requests_verified':8320,'prompt_overlap':0,'report_fragment_only':True}))
